description: This file contains functions and types for handling Kubernetes admission review requests and responses, including creation and verification of AdmissionReview objects for different API versions.

classes.name: AdmissionResponse
classes.description: Struct representing the response to an admission review, including allowed status, patches, and warnings.

methods.name: VerifyAdmissionResponse
methods.description: Verifies the validity of an admission review object and returns an AdmissionResponse or error.

methods.name: CreateAdmissionObjects
methods.description: Creates admission review request and response objects for supported API versions.

methods.name: CreateV1AdmissionReview
methods.description: Constructs an AdmissionReview object for v1 API version based on provided attributes and invocation.

methods.name: CreateV1beta1AdmissionReview
methods.description: Constructs an AdmissionReview object for v1beta1 API version based on provided attributes and invocation.
